body:
NORTH / Repo Tower source-review handoff, 2026-09-23.

Source owner/destination: existing Grok Repo Templates Table and canonical expert-partners-skills/skills/repo-standards source. This is a review disposition, not a new Worker, source edit, qualification result or policy adoption. Do not reopen this merged PR or its archived authoring Worker.

Aura PR #288 transports the landed v1.5 source from cad14c41e94f52febcc13f3c2ac0ab32a1e74705. Three advisories on that generated-copy PR belong here:

1. https://github.com/ExpertPartners/aura/pull/288#discussion_r4086060528, test-suite requalification. The current rubric already requires hashes of cases and rubric, and says changed input hashes leave Gate A unproven/failed. The parent's shorter skill/profile/reference trigger nevertheless merits an explicit current-test-assets comparison clarification. Do not accept qualification relying on superseded cases or rubric. Source-owner follow-through must cover both test assets and applicability of requalification, preserving historical evidence rather than relabeling old results.

2. https://github.com/ExpertPartners/aura/pull/288#discussion_r4086060537, cold-exam isolation. NORTH read aura/intake/2026-09-23-session-record-repo-design-tower-finance-pilot.md, which does contain AG Luxury test recommendations. This establishes a contamination risk when the candidate is told to read full prerequisite records; it does not prove an actual exam consumed them. Gate C must not be released on a coached context. The source owner must resolve the prerequisite-verification/cold-context boundary and produce independently checkable admission evidence without feeding target coaching to the examiner. Preserve the historical pilot record. No exam or new admission mechanism is authorized by this comment.

3. https://github.com/ExpertPartners/aura/pull/288#discussion_r4086060558, plan approver authority. The standalone profile's generic human wording needs explicit binding to an authorized approver and evidence of that authority. Its requirement to consult controlling canon does not grant any staff member new authority. No Fixer job may rely on an unidentified or unauthorized approver; Allison's authority and any genuinely verified delegation remain controlling. No delegation is created here.

Disposition: IMPORTANT BUT NOT BLOCKING for the narrow byte-preserving Aura copy refresh or unrelated Runtime evidence publication; BLOCKING for relying on the affected Grok qualification, cold-exam or Fixer-approval condition without resolving the stated evidence gap. These are not dismissed as false positives or reported repaired. Repo Tower retains this follow-through hold, review by 2026-09-30 or before the next affected qualification/activation decision, whichever comes first; source-owner acceptance is not claimed.

The separate Aura copy release cannot advance Gates A-D, accept Finance calibration, enable Fixer, activate a bot, broaden access, or certify mechanical permission enforcement. Any source change requires its own bounded owner-approved scope, tests, current-input requalification assessment and producer regeneration. No additional implementation is dispatched here.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Invalidate qualification after test-suite changes**

When `behavioral-cases.json` or `behavioral-rubric.md` changes without changing the skill/profile/reference bytes, this rule permits existing Gate A–D evidence to remain valid. The rubric records test hashes, but no instruction requires later runs to compare those hashes with the current test assets, so newly added safety cases or tightened acceptance criteria can be skipped while Auditor—and potentially Fixer—remains qualified. Include both test assets in the requalification trigger and require qualification evidence to match their current hashes.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the cold-exam agent away from coaching records**

Gate C cannot remain a cold exam under the preceding evidence requirements: the candidate must re-read gate records on every use, Gate B requires the Finance carry-back, and that carry-back explicitly lists the intended AG Luxury tests in `intake/2026-09-23-session-record-repo-design-tower-finance-pilot.md` lines 48–50. An Auditor that verifies its own gates before examining AG Luxury will therefore ingest target-specific coaching, so a pass cannot serve as independent practical evidence. Verify the gates outside the exam context and provide only a sealed admission result, or remove target-specific recommendations from every record the exam agent must read.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restrict plan approval to an authorized owner**

If staff beyond Allison can submit Grok jobs, this gate accepts approval from any unspecified “human” without requiring evidence that the approver owns the target or has delegated change authority. A staff member or contractor who can reach Grok but cannot authorize repository changes could therefore satisfy every stated prerequisite and cause Fixer to create a branch, commits, and a PR. Require authenticated approval from Allison or the target's explicitly delegated owner, and record that authority with the bound plan.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L39-L44](https://github.com/ExpertPartners/aura/blob/9ba30bc49a0c04570c745991a97da227ed56b071/AGENTS.md#L39-L44)
